title: Original ANT contribution through materially useful PVG
deliverable: One original correct modest ANT theorem in which PVG contributes materially
exit_criterion: Certified original theorem or explicit strategic revision
claim_ceiling: No theorem until proof and literature certificates

title: Master bidirectional PVG ANT translation
deliverable: Reusable language kernel with exact bridges, loss audits, analytic transforms, and reverse ANT translation
exit_criterion: Kernel reaches certified L3 coverage on its declared core
claim_ceiling: Translation and transfer only

title: Build an original lemma and theorem pipeline
deliverable: Originality-audited lemma selection and one-theorem program
exit_criterion: At least one certified original lemma and theorem-attempt closure
claim_ceiling: No originality claim before literature and proof gates

title: Develop the native geometry of prime valuations
deliverable: Reusable theory of valuation points, axes, support, levels, simplices, arithmetic terrain, operations, and information-loss maps
exit_criterion: Core objects and operations are defined, certified, cross-linked, and separated from support-only projections
claim_ceiling: Known identities, exact finite results, and clearly labeled candidate mechanisms only

title: Develop additive support-face dynamics
deliverable: Certified definitions and finite theory for transitions, basins, overlap, closure depth, support fibers, and full-valuation refinements
exit_criterion: A coherent reusable theory with exact propositions, finite certificates, open questions, and reverse links to ANT
claim_ceiling: No global termination, universal depth bound, or asymptotic law without proof

title: Build a complete inverse geometry engine for Prime Valuation Geometry
deliverable: A reusable inverse engine spanning support preimages, integer fibers, prime fibers, orbit verification, and analytic reverse translation
exit_criterion: Certified inverse APIs and data contracts, at least three transfer principles, and one originality-audited lemma candidate materially using inverse PVG
claim_ceiling: Architecture and bounded certificates only until analytic transfer, literature, and proof gates pass

title: Connect axis addition and addition fibers to ANT
deliverable: Bidirectional bridges between PVG additive fibers and representation functions, Goldbach-type diagnostics, Fourier/residue channels, and analytic tools
exit_criterion: At least three certified transfer principles and one originality-audited lemma candidate
claim_ceiling: No Goldbach progress without a proved new ANT result

title: Build an ANT specialist mind with bidirectional PVG translation
deliverable: Operational knowledge graph and reasoning routes covering core ANT domains with ASSIM MATH OPS CERT PVG separation
exit_criterion: Task-bounded specialist benchmarks and certified operational coverage across the declared ANT core
claim_ceiling: No trained neural network or approved corpus claim until separately certified

title: Formalize reusable PVG foundations in Lean when task-driven
deliverable: Zero-sorry reusable Lean layer for valuation laws, support geometry, and load-bearing active lemmas
exit_criterion: Formal core covers the declared reusable foundation and active proof dependencies
claim_ceiling: Formalization verifies statements but does not create originality

title: Maintain reproducible computational and visual laboratories
deliverable: Tested Python tools, finite datasets, visual labs, 3D explanations, CI, and reproducible certificates
exit_criterion: Every active experiment is reproducible, bounded, linked to a goal, and classified
claim_ceiling: Experiment and visualization are not proof

title: Preserve project memory, goal traceability, and mandatory return paths
deliverable: Canonical goal registry, dependency graph, detour protocol, stage reviews, evidence links, and CI enforcement
exit_criterion: No active or queued task lacks a parent goal, closure criterion, evidence path, and return gate
claim_ceiling: Governance only; no mathematical claim

title: Maintain the Arabic analytic number theory encyclopedia as a supporting knowledge program
deliverable: Reviewed chapters, references, proofs, and operational knowledge returned to the Central Mind
exit_criterion: Planned encyclopedia roadmap completed with independent review
claim_ceiling: Book production is not research progress by itself

title: Produce rigorous visual and public exposition without diluting research claims
deliverable: Visual laboratories, educational explanations, and governed outreach artifacts linked to certified results
exit_criterion: Expository artifacts clearly separate definitions, finite evidence, and open claims
claim_ceiling: No research promotion from presentation quality

title: Close scale-heterogeneity diagnostic and proof-strategy pass
deliverable: Reproducible report, generated certificate, exact identity layer, empirical pattern layer, and named analytic gap
exit_criterion: Repair, CI, closure review, and merge or negative certificate
claim_ceiling: Diagnostic and conditional proof strategy

title: Release PVG ANT Language Kernel v1
deliverable: Eight canonical bridges with forward/reverse maps, loss, transform, gain, examples, and certificates
exit_criterion: Kernel audit passes and declared bridge set is reusable
claim_ceiling: L1 exact translation and certified L2 structural gains

title: Select one serious original lemma target
deliverable: Ten candidates, literature triage, three finalists, one frozen lemma target
exit_criterion: ONE-LEMMA-TARGET-001 readiness card approved
claim_ceiling: Candidate lemma only

title: Execute the first one-theorem program
deliverable: Proof, negative certificate, known-classical-consequence closure, or named missing certificate
exit_criterion: Full closure review for ONE-LEMMA-TARGET-001
claim_ceiling: Original lemma or theorem only after proof and literature certificates
blocked_by: external priority and proof responses pending
next_review: on external response under P8 stopping protocol or owner-authorized internal proof review
return_gate: ENGINE-002 return completed; no second theorem target or new external packets without owner authorization

title: Synthesize support-fiber dynamics before further search
deliverable: A clean mathematical synthesis of PASS-013 through PASS-024 with definitions, exact propositions, numerical examples, full-PVG versus support-projection loss map, finite/open classification, and ANT reverse links
exit_criterion: SYNTHESIS-001 closure review passes; every claim is tagged exact, finite, known, reinterpretation, candidate, or open; reusable knowledge is returned to the language kernel

title: PASS-025 inverse geometry engine prototype: reverse support, integer, prime, and orbit layers
deliverable: A certified bounded prototype of the inverse geometry engine plus a depth-twelve witness or finite negative certificate
exit_criterion: PASS-025 audit and Stage Review identify result, limit, knowledge return, and next return action

return_gate: fulfilled by return decision; PASS-026 not authorized

title: ENGINE-002 general inverse-support kernel
deliverable: A sound and complete inverse-support API for binary and multi-axis predecessor faces inside a frozen finite box, with reachability certificates
exit_criterion: Independent brute-force equality, deterministic JSON regeneration, multi-axis tests, negative certificates, CI, and Stage Review all pass
claim_ceiling: Finite exact infrastructure only; no global reachability, termination, depth-growth, or ANT theorem
return_gate: fulfilled by return decision; Phase B and depth search not authorized

title: Formal and publication closure
deliverable: Final literature audit, manual proof, optional Lean certificate, adversarial review, and manuscript
exit_criterion: Reviewable manuscript or publication-level negative assessment
claim_ceiling: Publication claim only after full certificates
